description.text: The School of Information Science is constituted of Information Management Department, Computer Science and Technology Department, E-Commerce Department, Public Teaching Department, Specialized Labs, Career Design Studio and other auxiliary teaching organizations. There are 22 professors and associate professors, 33 PhDs (including PhD candidates), and 866 undergraduates. In recent years, the school has engaged in around 10 ministerial and provincial research projects, and taken part in 'Golden Audit project' and '863 Project' and other national projects. Over 600 theses have been published in journals like Soft Science Journal, Computer Science. Around 10 treatises including Audit of the computer information management have been issued by the department. The school has also won several awards in teaching and research. B.A. E-Commerce Objectives: This program fosters students of E-Commerce who possess solid knowledge of economic management and sense of modern business, and master theories, knowledge, skills and study methods of the information science. They are expected to be able to carry out business activities by using Internet, as well as to develop, apply and manage the E-Commerce, with spirit to innovate and ability to practice. Graduates are expected to be able to carry out scientific research and E-Commerce application in IT industry, governmental institutions, trading companies, enterprises, administrative departments, and research institutions. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Management Degree Main Courses: Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, Statistics, Management, Information Systems Management, Computer Network, Marketing, Economic Law, Network Economics, General E-Commerce, Basic of E-Commerce Technology, Network Marketing, Network Banking and E-payment, Management of E-Commerce Logistics, E-Commerce Law.

duration.text: The Electronic Commerce at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2333 USD/per year ￥ 16800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
